subject: Culture
title: Face Saving
description: A short lesson to help you apply Face Saving.

hook.text: In China, publicly correcting your boss would be career suicide. You protect their face, always.

buildup.text: Face is social currency in East Asia. Losing it means shame for you and everyone connected to you.

discovery.text: Sociologist Erving Goffman showed that Westerners manage face too—they just call it reputation.

twist.text: In the Middle East, face extends to the entire family. One member's disgrace stains all of them.

climax.text: Every culture has a face system. The difference is how far the damage spreads when it breaks.

punchline.text: Reputation is personal in the West, collective in the East.

quiz.question: Which sociologist studied 'face' management in Western societies?
